verdict.rationale: Mirrors has its own capture hooks: an SDK capture uploads a full snapshot in the background, a final capture records how each execution ended, and these are stored as traces/sessions you can review and preview corrections against. However, it positions observability as a separate category that fits alongside Langfuse, LangSmith and Braintrust, and nothing documents per-call inputs/outputs, latency, or token usage fields. Missing for 10: documented per-LLM-call input/output trace structure, latency capture, token usage capture, trace viewer/instrumentation docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
